Package dev.turboism.sdk.cubism

Interface CubismPlugin

All Superinterfaces:
AnimationFileHooks, DeformerHooks, DrawableHooks, EditorLifecycleHooks, ModelFileHooks, ParameterHooks, PartHooks, SemanticOperationHooks, TurboismPlugin
public interface CubismPlugin extends TurboismPlugin, ParameterHooks, PartHooks, DrawableHooks, DeformerHooks, ModelFileHooks, AnimationFileHooks, EditorLifecycleHooks, SemanticOperationHooks
Convenience plugin contract for Cubism integrations.

Plugins override only the lifecycle methods they need. Runtime discovery is based on the inherited hook interfaces; no callback registration is required.
